decisions.reason: The signature and letter-photo instructions do not change how the four biographies are integrated into the appendix.
The one-page constraint applies specifically to the proposal letter and does not alter the existing overall RFQ page-limit goal.
The source does not change the inclusion or replacement of proposal tables.
Relocating two photos if necessary does not change the required sequence of RFQ sections.
The source does not change whether or how the table of contents is included.
The letter layout, signature insertion, and photo relocation instructions do not resolve or alter required narrative-section content.
The source does not change the requirement to incorporate the organization chart into the final draft.
The photo-placement impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY requiring relocation of the two favorite photos if they do not fit.
The source introduces localized letter-layout and editing constraints without changing the established full-document visual treatment.
Being able to insert a signature in the current Canva file does not resume or modify the deferred reusable-template requirement.
The source does not change the Agua Arc brand identity, logo source, or color source.
The client adds a concrete editing capability for the Canva source: she must be able to insert her signature easily.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: 2) The letter will be one page, and I also need to insert my signature. I’m hoping I can handle that easily in Canva. However, the two pictures currently placed on the letter’s second page are two of my favorites for this proposal, so if they won’t fit in the one-page letter, I hope you can relocate them to another section.

value_updates.signature_insertion_in_canva: The client must be able to insert her signature easily in Canva.
